outcome: Implemented a deterministic pure Kotlin/JVM combat reducer on top of the accepted EFB-002 BoardEngine. The candidate includes strict phases, player resources, enemy intent preview/resolution, board-intent effects, Wall/Overflow integration, integration events for card-boundary intents, and a stable combat digest.
implemented: Draw → Weave → Cast → Wall → Enemy → Cleanup plus terminal Victory/Defeat.
Atomic command transitions; illegal board taps and invalid phase commands reject without state mutation.
Three base Taps; accepted Tap pays capped hue Ink, converts overflow to Spark, applies chip damage after enemy Block, applies Brand Vigil cost, and advances Spectrum using EFB-002 BoardEngine.
Player Vigil, Block, Flasks and enemy Vigor/Block.
Deterministic two-intent forecast bound to a fixed data-driven intent sequence; resolved intent equals the first forecast.
Strike, Ash Row, Stone Seed, Stain, Fog, Seal, Brand, Surge, Snatch and Curse.
Wall/Overflow and Seal durations delegated to EFB-002 BoardEngine.
Cast integration seams for card damage, Block and intent delay; Snatch/Curse emit explicit EFB-004 integration events.
Stable replay digest binds board, player/enemy resources, complete intent sequence/cursor, forecast and status counters.
Defensively immutable combat snapshots, player Ink, intent sequences, Brand targets and wall-row commands.
Sealed-column incoming rows remain frozen through Wall insertion and enemy Ash Row/Stain effects, honoring ADR-012 at the combat integration boundary.
Card Pop integration command during Cast: resolves board Pop without spending a Weave Tap or decrementing Fog's three-Tap duration.
Versioned command replay frames with per-step checkpoint digests and explicit rejected-command frames.
